title: RIVO: Lightweight Adaptive Rerouting for Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.15910v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep Research agents rely on long-horizon reasoning and iterative tool use to solve complex information-seeking tasks. However, adaptive decision-making over these trajectories remains challenging, as agents may stop prematurely when further evidence is needed, continue unnecessarily after sufficient evidence has been gathered, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories. Existing solutions either require costly model retraining and dense turn-level supervision, or rely on heuristic control rules that are not directly optimized for downstream research utility. This motivates a lightweight, utility-aware alternative for Deep Research control. We formulate adaptive rerouting in long-horizon Deep Research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem. translated_title: RIVO：面向深度研究智能体的轻量级自适应重路由
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体依赖长程推理与迭代式工具调用来解决复杂的信息检索任务。然而，在这类轨迹上进行自适应决策仍然极具挑战性：智能体可能在仍需更多证据时过早停止，在证据已充分的情况下继续不必要地探索，或无法及时纠正无效的研究轨迹。现有方案要么需要代价高昂的模型重训练和密集的轮次级监督，要么依赖并未针对下游研究效用进行直接优化的启发式控制规则。这促使我们寻求一种轻量级的、感知效用的深度研究控制替代方案。我们将长程深度研究中的自适应重路由形式化为一个基于状态的轨迹纠正问题。基于这一视角，我们提出了RIVO——一个用于自适应轨迹纠正的轻量级即插即用框架。智能体从轻量级信号中估计其研究状态，并据此检测（原文在此处截断）
tldr: RIVO提出了一种轻量级即插即用框架，将深度研究智能体的自适应重路由形式化为基于状态的轨迹纠正问题，无需昂贵的模型重训练或密集监督即可纠正过早停止、过度探索及无效轨迹等问题。
en_tdlr: RIVO is a lightweight plug-in framework that formulates adaptive rerouting in deep research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem, correcting premature stopping, unnecessary continuation, and unproductive trajectories without costly retraining or dense supervision.
